q.en: What game did Pluto love to play with the other planets?
q.zh: 冥王星喜欢和其他行星玩什么游戏？

options.en: Hide and Seek, which the planets played every night
options.zh: 捉迷藏，行星们每晚都玩这个

explain.en: The book says Pluto loved to play the Brag and Tag game with the other planets.
explain.zh: 书中说冥王星喜欢和其他行星玩“炫耀与追逐”（Brag and Tag）游戏。

q.en: According to the other planets, why was Pluto no longer considered a planet?
q.zh: 根据其他行星的说法，为什么冥王星不再被视为行星？

options.en: He was too tiny and had a messy orbit
options.zh: 它太小，而且运行轨道很杂乱

options.en: He was too far from the Sun, so he could not feel its heat at all
options.zh: 它离太阳太远，所以它完全感觉不到太阳的热

explain.en: The planets said Pluto was 'too tiny to be a planet' and had a 'messy orbit' full of rocks and ice chunks.
explain.zh: 行星们说冥王星“太小，不能算行星”，而且有一条“杂乱的轨道”，里面满是岩石和冰块。

q.en: Who is Charon in the story?

options.en: A new dwarf planet discovered just last year
options.zh: 一颗去年才被发现的新矮行星

explain.en: Charon is described as Pluto's largest moon, who tries to cheer Pluto up by pointing out that Pluto has three moons.
explain.zh: 卡戎被描述为冥王星最大的卫星，它提醒冥王星说自己有三颗卫星，试图让它振作起来。

q.en: The book says the planets' humming sounded like...
q.zh: 书中说行星们哼唱的声音听起来像……

options.en: Wind blowing, like a soft breeze through space
options.zh: 风吹声，像太空里的一阵微风

explain.en: When the planets hummed, the book says 'It sounded lovely, like bells ringing.'
explain.zh: 行星们哼唱时，书中写道：“声音很动听，就像铃铛在响。”

q.en: The word "griped" is used when Pluto complains about all the junk in his orbit. What does "griped" mean?
q.zh: 当冥王星抱怨轨道里全是垃圾时，用到了“griped”这个词。它的意思是？

options.en: He was sleeping after a long trip around the Sun
options.zh: 他在绕太阳长途旅行之后睡着了

explain.en: The context shows Pluto was unhappy about the junk, so 'griped' means he complained.
explain.zh: 语境显示冥王星对垃圾感到不满，所以“griped”意思是他在抱怨。

q.en: What do dwarf planets have in common with regular planets, and how are they different?
q.zh: 矮行星和普通行星有哪些相同之处，又有什么不同？

options.en: They do not orbit the Sun
They are like planets but share their orbits with other objects
options.zh: 它们像行星，但与其他天体共享轨道

options.en: They are exactly the same as planets in size, shape, and number of moons
options.zh: 它们和行星完全一样，在大小、形状和卫星数量上都一样

explain.en: Eris tells Pluto, 'We're just like planets, only we share our orbits with other objects.'
explain.zh: 厄里斯告诉冥王星：“我们就像行星一样，只是我们与其他天体共享轨道。”

q.en: Based on the story, what is the Kuiper Belt?
q.zh: 根据故事内容，柯伊伯带（Kuiper Belt）是什么？

options.en: The Sun's surface, where Eris says the ice is so thick that spacecraft can land on it and take pictures, and she claims astronauts have built a small town there
options.zh: 太阳的表面，厄里斯说那里的冰厚得能让宇宙飞船降落并拍照，她还说宇航员已经在那里建起了一座小镇

options.en: The neighborhood of dwarf planets made of frozen gases and rocks left from the solar system's beginning
options.zh: 矮行星的聚集地，由太阳系形成时遗留的冰冻气体和岩石组成

explain.en: Eris says the Kuiper Belt is 'our neighborhood' made of frozen gases and rocks left over from when the solar system began.
explain.zh: 厄里斯说柯伊伯带是“我们的家园”，由太阳系形成时遗留的冰冻气体和岩石组成。

q.en: What was the author's main reason for writing this story?
q.zh: 作者写这个故事的主要目的是什么？

options.en: To report real news about space travel from a newspaper in the year 2100
options.zh: 报道来自2100年一家报纸的关于太空旅行的真实新闻

options.en: To describe how to build a telescope
To argue that Pluto should be a planet
options.zh: 主张冥王星应该是一颗行星

options.en: To teach readers about dwarf planets in a fun, story-like way
options.zh: 以有趣的故事形式向读者介绍矮行星

explain.en: The story uses friendly characters and a game to explain real facts about dwarf planets and the Kuiper Belt.
explain.zh: 故事用亲切的角色和一个游戏来解释关于矮行星和柯伊伯带的真实知识。

q.en: Why does the author give Pluto human feelings like sadness and pride?
q.zh: 作者为什么赋予冥王星悲伤、骄傲等人类情感？

options.en: To make the science easier to enjoy and relate to
options.zh: 让科学知识更容易被人喜爱和产生共鸣

options.en: To show that planets are alive
Because Pluto is actually a person who goes to school on Earth
options.zh: 因为冥王星其实是一个人，他在地球上上学

explain.en: By giving Pluto emotions, the author makes the science story more engaging and helps readers care about the characters.
explain.zh: 通过赋予冥王星情感，作者让科普故事更有吸引力，也帮助读者关心角色。

q.en: Which dwarf planet takes the longest time to orbit the Sun, according to the story?
q.zh: 根据故事内容，哪颗矮行星绕太阳运行的时间最长？

explain.en: Pluto learns that Eris takes the longest time to orbit the Sun, while Ceres takes the shortest.
explain.zh: 冥王星了解到厄里斯绕太阳运行的时间最长，而谷神星用时最短。

prompt.en: If you were Pluto, how would you feel about being reclassified as a dwarf planet, and what would you say to the planets that voted you out?
prompt.zh: 如果你是冥王星，被重新归类为矮行星你会有什么感受？你会对那些投票把你除名的行星说些什么？

guidance.en:
• Pluto felt sad and like 'a nobody' after being told he was no longer a planet.
• Eris helps him see that being a dwarf planet means sharing an orbit with other objects, not being unimportant.
• Pluto ends the story proud to be a dwarf planet with new friends.
guidance.zh:
• 冥王星被告知不再是行星后感到难过，像个“无名小卒”。
• 厄里斯让他明白，矮行星只是与其他天体共享轨道，并不代表不重要。
• 故事结尾冥王星为自己成为有朋友相伴的矮行星而感到骄傲。
